summary: Iteration 25 — Course-Complete page, PDF certificate, intro video on course details, and auto-redirect from CapstoneCompletePage. Backend sanity confirmed, frontend live tests + code review passed. One minor spec deviation in video positioning noted.

issues: Spec said intro video should sit BETWEEN 'What you'll be able to do' section and the animated stats. Actual DOM order is: detail-hero -> detail-intro-video-section -> detail-stats-reveal -> detail-what-you-learn -> detail-modules-section. Intro video renders ABOVE both the animated stats AND the What-You-Learn section, so it is not 'between' them as required. Functionality works but placement doesn't match the brief.

action_items: OPTIONAL: reorder sections in CourseDetailsPage.jsx so detail-intro-video-section sits between detail-what-you-learn and detail-stats-reveal (spec: 'below What you'll be able to do and above the animated stats'). Currently the intro video is placed before both.
critical_code_review_comments: CourseCompletePage.jsx (422 LOC) — logic clean, uses jsPDF at runtime; html2canvas is installed but unused, safe to remove to shrink bundle.

Certificate PDF: recipient name uses helvetica bold at 38pt centered (line 118-121); issue date uses new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {day:'2-digit', month:'long', year:'numeric'}) inside handleDownload (line 221) — computed at CLICK time not on mount, matching the user requirement 'change the date of issue to the date user has downloaded the certificate'.
Cert ID format: `VV-${today.getFullYear()}-${String(user.id).slice(0,8).toUpperCase()}` (line 222) — matches spec VV-YYYY-USERPREFIX.

Empty full_name flow works: handleDownload line 214-215 does `if (!name) { setAskName(true); ... return; }` BEFORE downloading. On next click after name is filled, line 219 persists it to profiles via supabase.from('profiles').update({full_name}).eq('id', user.id) — best-effort, wrapped in try/catch.

CapstoneCompletePage.jsx auto-redirect (line 259-278): queries user_enrollments -> master_capstone_projects vs user_capstone_projects (enrollment_scoped) and navigate('/course-complete', {replace:true}) when done>=total. Silent catch keeps user on capstone page if the query fails — good defensive default.

CourseDetailsPage.jsx intro video section (line 420-439): <video controls preload='metadata' playsInline> pointing to correct customer-assets URL; wrapped in border+shadow container; has 'Watch the intro' eyebrow. Testids `detail-intro-video-section` and `detail-intro-video` both present.

MINOR: The full-congrats branch of CourseCompletePage is unreachable via live test today (admin has no completed capstones); reviewed by reading JSX — all required testids and stat cards are present (`course-complete-page`, `course-complete-headline`, `course-complete-edge-panel`, `course-complete-cert-panel`, `course-complete-download-btn`, `course-complete-back-dashboard`, `course-complete-name-panel`, `course-complete-name-input`, `course-complete-downloaded-badge`). Stats: Modules 22, Sessions 246, Simulations 246, Capstones dynamic N/N — matches spec. Six edge bullets present. Footer copy present.
